notes.title: Head 2 Head 1.0 Release Approaching!
notes.notes:
We want to thank everyone who has played Head 2 Head so far in its early access state. All the comments and feedback we've received over the early access period has been very valuable to us.

We are nearing the 1.0 release of Head 2 Head and we'd like to talk about some changes that are coming with that.

UI Changes

With 1.0 coming, we wanted to streamline the UI to look and feel cleaner and more responsive. We've taken some inspiration from some really cool UI from other games and we hope that you enjoy the changes!

Skullteria

Skullteria will be gems that you can equip to take on your journey through the headless realm. Skullteria contain buffs, magic spells, bonuses and other unique features, but they are persistent across all roguelike modes. You will gain Skullteria Exp whenever you defeat an enemy and they will level up, up to 5 stars, strengthening whatever bonus may be contained. The skullteria system will initially hold stats, but will develop deeper past 1.0.

Head Changes

With the addition of Skullteria, we've decided to change things about the heads you obtain. Each Head will have their own unique bonus as well as randomly generated bonuses that are rolled whenever you obtain the Head. Head's will also have a random number of Skullteria sockets rolled upon creation. Skullteria sockets are color coordinated, so you can only slot same color Skuklteria into Head sockets. The only exception to this rule is White Skullteria and White sockets. White Skullteria can slot into any socket. Any skullteria can slot into White Head sockets.

In addition to all of this, there is a new Head merging system to star your heads up. They no longer automatically star up if you obtain duplicates. You will have to manually select a Head to star up along with a different copy of the same Head at the same star level to sacrifice for the star up. With the randomly generated buffs on heads and rolled skullteria slot colors.

In-Game Drops and Currency

With the expanding game modes and depth of enemy interactions comes new rewards in the form of item and currency drops. These things will be used to improve your characters, level up Heads and Skullteria and tons of other things.

There are in-game currencies called Chromatic Orbs and Radiant Orbs that will allow you to reroll the color of a Head slot or turn it White respectively. There are also currencies called Master's Chisel and Master's Hammer to roll a chance to add a new Skullteria slot to a head or have a 100% chance to add one respectively. These in-game currencies can be obtained in normal gameplay and dropped from defeated enemies.

There will be more additions to items and currency post 1.0.

Price Change

We initially had Head 2 Head priced at $9.99 but we felt that we wanted to take the opportunity to get as much feedback about the game as we could, so we made the game free during early access.

Now that Early Access is ending, and we have added a significant amount of new content to the game, we are releasing Head 2 Head at $14.99. Don't worry, for anyone who has already obtained Head 2 Head for free in Early Access, you will keep the game and all of your progress for free.

Nintendo Switch Release

Sometime after Head 2 Head launches on Steam, we will be launching Head 2 Head on the Ninteno Switch at the same price point of $14.99. We will be aiming to have crossplay for online versus and we'll also be aiming to have cross progression via Epic Online Services.

Thank you so much for your continued support of our first game and we hope the new changes to the world we've built will keep you coming back for more!

notes.title: HEAD 2 HEAD 0.8.0 UPDATE
notes.notes:
MAJOR UPDATE

Head 2 Head's Survival mode gets a huge Roguelike update!

In Survival mode, you get 3 randomly rolled stat buffs of different rarities after each battle. You get 5 after each boss fight. These buffs can help you reach higher and higher into the survival tower. If you come across some weak buffs that are not helpful, you can spend Skull Tokens to reroll your buff spread.

WAY MORE content and updates coming to Head 2 Head. Stay tuned!
